# ArkFlame Studios

> ArkFlame Studios builds Minecraft plugins. Anticheat, lag limiters and proxies for Bukkit, Paper, Folia and Velocity servers.

ArkFlame Studios publishes Minecraft server plugins for Bukkit, Spigot, Paper, Folia, BungeeCord and Velocity servers. Products are grouped into security, performance, network, gameplay and SMP categories. Documentation covers selected plugins. Guides cover setup tasks across several products.

Full text of every guide and doc: https://arkflame.com/llms-full.txt

## Categories

- [Security](https://arkflame.com/plugins/security/): Exploit protection, anticheat, authentication and abuse prevention for Minecraft servers and networks.
- [Performance](https://arkflame.com/plugins/performance/): Server optimization tools for entity pressure, redstone abuse, runtime stability and high-load environments.
- [Network](https://arkflame.com/plugins/network/): Proxy infrastructure for secure Minecraft networks built around Velocity and Bungee-compatible environments.
- [Gameplay](https://arkflame.com/plugins/gameplay/): PvP, practice, minigame and player-facing systems built for multiplayer Minecraft.
- [SMP](https://arkflame.com/plugins/smp/): Survival systems for combat, regions, farming, lifesteal, moderation, menus and progression.

## Products


### Security

- [ExploitFixer](https://arkflame.com/plugins/exploitfixer/): Protects servers from crash, dupe and packet-exploit abuse.
- [FairPlay](https://arkflame.com/plugins/fairplay/): Combat anticheat with 169+ checks, local AI and Grim hooks.
- [AuthMe Premium](https://arkflame.com/plugins/authme-premium/): Auto-login bridge for premium players using AuthMe, with proxy/Geyser-oriented workflows.
- [ChatSentinel](https://arkflame.com/plugins/chatsentinel/): Regex-based anti-swear and anti-spam chat moderation.
- [ChatSentinel Premium](https://arkflame.com/plugins/chatsentinel-premium/): Premium smart chat-filter configuration for spam/swear protection.
- [AAC + AACAP Balanced Configuration](https://arkflame.com/plugins/aac-aacap-config/): Balanced AAC/AACAP anticheat configuration focused on protection, performance and lower false positives.

### Performance

- [RedstoneLimiter](https://arkflame.com/plugins/redstonelimiter/): Limits expensive redstone contraptions and exploit lag machines.
- [FlameStack](https://arkflame.com/plugins/flamestack/): Stacks ground items and redstone-machine outputs to reduce server load; public listing advertises Folia support.
- [MobStacker](https://arkflame.com/plugins/mobstacker/): Stacks mobs to reduce entity pressure and server load.
- [BlockLimiter](https://arkflame.com/plugins/blocklimiter/): Limits block counts per chunk to control expensive server structures; public listing advertises Folia support.
- [EntityLimiter](https://arkflame.com/plugins/entitylimiter/): Limits entity pressure to prevent crash/lag conditions.
- [FlamePaper](https://arkflame.com/plugins/flamepaper/): Paper 1.8.8 fork focused on security, performance, stability, patches, knockback, tick loop and redstone behavior.

### Network

- [FlameCord](https://arkflame.com/plugins/flamecord/): Secure BungeeCord/Waterfall-compatible replacement proxy with anti-bot/anti-crash focus.
- [VeloFlame](https://arkflame.com/plugins/veloflame/): Velocity-based proxy focused on performance and protection against bot attacks.
- [DiscordFlow](https://arkflame.com/plugins/discordflow/): Minecraft/Discord role sync, chat sync, proximity voice and console-access integration.

### Gameplay

- [FlamePractice](https://arkflame.com/plugins/flamepractice/): PvP practice system for duels, ranked play and FFA.
- [FloatingHeads](https://arkflame.com/plugins/floatingheads/): Floating-head visual/NPC/hologram effects for Minecraft servers.
- [MineClans](https://arkflame.com/plugins/mineclans/): Factions-style clan system with power, land claiming, alliances and events.
- [HarvestableBlocks](https://arkflame.com/plugins/harvestableblocks/): Mining/farming zones with regenerating blocks/crops and WorldGuard-oriented workflows.
- [EssentialsLite](https://arkflame.com/plugins/essentialslite/): Modern essentials command suite; current listing advertises Folia support.
- [SquidGameX](https://arkflame.com/plugins/squidgamex/): Runs large Squid Game-style Minecraft events.
- [Disasters](https://arkflame.com/plugins/disasters/): Minecraft implementation inspired by Hypixel's Disasters minigame.
- [SH-Pets](https://arkflame.com/plugins/sh-pets/): Companion/pet system with abilities and events.
- [FlamePearls](https://arkflame.com/plugins/flamepearls/): Fixes ender-pearl glitch behavior and supports stasis-chamber limiting.
- [FancyGlow](https://arkflame.com/plugins/fancyglow/): Lets VIP players select glow colors using TAB integration.
- [MineClasses](https://arkflame.com/plugins/mineclasses/): Armor-based MMORPG/HCF classes with automatic potion effects.
- [StaffModeX](https://arkflame.com/plugins/staffmodex/): Staff-mode tooling with public listing support for HEX, Redis and MySQL.
- [sLevels](https://arkflame.com/plugins/slevels/): Server-level progression and rewards.
- [Leash Workers](https://arkflame.com/plugins/leash-workers/): Leashes entities/players and lets villagers perform configured jobs.
- [SH-Koth](https://arkflame.com/plugins/sh-koth/): King-of-the-Hill event system.
- [HubCombat](https://arkflame.com/plugins/hubcombat/): Adds lobby PvP and weapons.
- [Lucky Pillars](https://arkflame.com/plugins/lucky-pillars/): Pillars of Fortune minigame implementation.
- [MineKoth](https://arkflame.com/plugins/minekoth/): Time-limited capture-the-hill events with rewards.
- [NextRTP](https://arkflame.com/plugins/nextrtp/): Lightweight random-teleport plugin.
- [Crates](https://arkflame.com/plugins/crates-hcf/): HCF-oriented crate/reward system.
- [FlameForge](https://arkflame.com/plugins/flameforge/): Custom weapons, upgrades and reforging mechanics.

### SMP

- [FlameOrders](https://arkflame.com/plugins/flameorders/): Server-synchronized orders and deliveries; public listing advertises Folia support.
- [SMP Lifesteal](https://arkflame.com/plugins/smp-lifesteal/): Lifesteal core for SMP progression; public listing advertises Folia support.
- [SMP Protections](https://arkflame.com/plugins/smp-protections/): ProtectionStones-style protection system with menus and Folia support.
- [ProtectionStones Extras](https://arkflame.com/plugins/protectionstones-extras/): GUI management, region flags and bans for ProtectionStones workflows.
- [SMP Shards](https://arkflame.com/plugins/smp-shards/): AFK-earned shard currency and shop system; public listing advertises Folia support.
- [SMP Punishments](https://arkflame.com/plugins/smp-punishments/): Punishment/moderation suite with voice-chat mute support.
- [SMP Weapons](https://arkflame.com/plugins/smp-weapons/): Configurable legendary weapons for SMP/PvP/FFA with premade weapons.
- [FlameShop](https://arkflame.com/plugins/flameshop/): Shop, sell and worth plugin for Economy SMP servers.
- [SMP Combat](https://arkflame.com/plugins/smp-combat/): Combat-tag system with legacy-combat, WorldGuard-barrier and elytra restrictions.
- [SMP Menus](https://arkflame.com/plugins/smp-menus/): Help/rules menu system positioned as a modern DeluxeMenus alternative; current listing advertises Folia support.
- [FlameSpawners](https://arkflame.com/plugins/flamespawners/): Item-producing configurable spawner system with stacking, storage/upgrades and public Folia support claim.
- [SMP Lobby](https://arkflame.com/plugins/smp-lobby/): Lobby system with PvP, announcements, protection, titles, redirect and void protection.
- [SMP Crates](https://arkflame.com/plugins/smp-crates/): Modern configurable crates; current listing advertises Folia support.
- [SMP Harvest](https://arkflame.com/plugins/smp-harvest/): Harvest progression with upgradable hoes, XP, tokens and rewards.
- [SMP Regions](https://arkflame.com/plugins/smp-regions/): WorldGuard-alternative region system with extra flags and resettable areas; current listing advertises Folia support.
- [SMP Rewards](https://arkflame.com/plugins/smp-rewards/): Daily/hourly rewards with streak, menu and playtime mechanics; public listing advertises Folia support.

## Documentation

- [AuthMe Premium install and topology](https://arkflame.com/docs/authme-premium/): How AuthMe Premium's proxy session bridge modes differ and what each backend needs.
- [BlockLimiter per-chunk block limits](https://arkflame.com/docs/blocklimiter/): BlockLimiter caps block counts per chunk, set per block type, to limit load and persistence cost from dense player builds. Compatibility overview.
- [ChatSentinel chat filtering and SocialSpy](https://arkflame.com/docs/chatsentinel/): ChatSentinel filters chat for spam, swearing, advertising and client mentions, with server mute, SocialSpy and Redis alerts. Commands and permissions.
- [Crates features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/crates-hcf/): Crates is an HCF-oriented crate and reward system. The plugin descriptor covers a single command and requires HolographicDisplays.
- [Disasters features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/disasters/): Disasters implements a Hypixel-style Disasters minigame on Paper. The current source targets Paper 26.2 and Java 25, and requires WorldEdit.
- [DiscordFlow features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/discordflow/): DiscordFlow connects a Minecraft network to Discord for role sync, chat sync, proximity voice and console access.
- [EntityLimiter entity caps](https://arkflame.com/docs/entitylimiter/): EntityLimiter sets hard caps on entity counts to prevent crash and lag from entity pressure. Compatibility and configuration overview.
- [EssentialsLite features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/essentialslite/): EssentialsLite is a broad essentials command suite covering teleports, homes, kits, warps and administration.
- [ExploitFixer quick start](https://arkflame.com/docs/exploitfixer/): Packet-level crash and exploit filter for Spigot, Paper, and Folia servers, built around the required HamsterAPI packet engine.
- [FairPlay quick start](https://arkflame.com/docs/fairplay/): Combat anticheat that applies mitigation against flagged players, with built-in checks and optional GrimAC or Vulcan flag hooks.
- [FancyGlow features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/fancyglow/): FancyGlow lets eligible players choose a glow colour through a menu, with TAB as the display integration. Glow definitions, menus and messages are configurable.
- [FlameCord quick start](https://arkflame.com/docs/flamecord/): BungeeCord and Waterfall fork proxy with antibot filtering, packet limits, and an optional iptables/ipset firewall module.
- [FlameForge features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/flameforge/): FlameForge adds custom weapons, upgrades and reforging. It documents Spigot, Paper and Folia support across 1.8.8 to 1.21.x and ships twenty-two permissions.
- [FlameOrders features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/flameorders/): FlameOrders provides server-synchronized orders and deliveries, with storage and network modes. It ships a command and permission table and supports Folia.
- [FlamePaper features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/flamepaper/): FlamePaper is a Paper 1.8.8 server fork carrying patches for stability, redstone behaviour, knockback and the tick loop.
- [FlamePearls features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/flamepearls/): FlamePearls corrects ender-pearl movement glitches and supports limiting stasis chambers. Behaviour is controlled from a single config file.
- [FlamePractice features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/flamepractice/): FlamePractice runs duel, ranked and FFA practice on a Spigot-based server.
- [FlameSpawners features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/flamespawners/): FlameSpawners adds configurable spawners with stacking, storage and upgrades.
- [FlameStack dropped-item stacking](https://arkflame.com/docs/flamestack/): FlameStack merges dropped items through a chunk-section index and a bounded reservation coordinator. Defaults, commands and Folia notes.
- [FloatingHeads features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/floatingheads/): FloatingHeads renders floating heads, NPC-style displays and holograms.
- [HarvestableBlocks features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/harvestableblocks/): HarvestableBlocks defines mining and farming zones whose blocks and crops regenerate after harvest. Zone protection plugins can govern where the loops run.
- [HubCombat features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/hubcombat/): HubCombat adds PvP and weapons to a lobby server. It targets Paper 1.21.7 with Java 21 and exposes a reload command plus an admin permission.
- [Leash Workers features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/leash-workers/): Leash Workers lets players leash entities and assigns configured jobs to villagers.
- [Lucky Pillars features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/lucky-pillars/): Lucky Pillars implements the Pillars of Fortune minigame. Five commands, twenty-four permissions and configuration for GUIs, hotbars and messages.
- [MineClans features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/mineclans/): MineClans provides clans with power, land claiming, alliances and events.
- [MineClasses features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/mineclasses/): MineClasses assigns MMORPG or HCF classes through armour and applies their potion effects automatically. Class definitions and messages are configurable.
- [MineKoth features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/minekoth/): MineKoth runs time-limited capture-the-hill events with rewards. It integrates with Vault, MineClans, UltimateClans, holograms and PlaceholderAPI.
- [MobStacker stacking and entity counts](https://arkflame.com/docs/mobstacker/): MobStacker merges nearby mobs of the same type to reduce entity counts and tick cost. Platforms, compatibility and configuration overview.
- [ProtectionStones Extras features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/protectionstones-extras/): ProtectionStones Extras adds GUI management, region flags and bans to ProtectionStones.
- [RedstoneLimiter configuration and monitor mode](https://arkflame.com/docs/redstonelimiter/): RedstoneLimiter scopes, presets, monitor mode, commands, permissions and configuration keys.
- [SH-Koth features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/sh-koth/): SH-Koth runs King-of-the-Hill events with Folia support. Operational documentation is maintained by the author.
- [SH-Pets features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/sh-pets/): SH-Pets adds companion pets with abilities and events. Ten pet definition files and a level curve sit behind a PacketEvents dependency.
- [sLevels features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/slevels/): sLevels adds server-wide level progression with rewards. Levels are defined in configuration and can run on Spigot, Paper or Folia.
- [SMP Combat features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/smp-combat/): SMP Combat adds combat tags with legacy-combat, WorldGuard-barrier and elytra restrictions. Ten configuration files cover the rules.
- [SMP Crates features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/smp-crates/): SMP Crates is a configurable crate system. It documents Bukkit, Spigot and Paper 1.8–1.21+ support and declares Folia compatibility.
- [SMP Harvest features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/smp-harvest/): SMP Harvest adds harvest progression with upgradable hoes, XP, tokens and rewards. Eight configuration files and thirty-two permissions cover the loop.
- [SMP Lifesteal commands and configuration](https://arkflame.com/docs/smp-lifesteal/): SMP Lifesteal commands, permissions, storage defaults and heart-death settings for survival servers.
- [SMP Lobby features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/smp-lobby/): SMP Lobby builds a lobby server with PvP, announcements, protection, titles, redirect and void protection.
- [SMP Menus features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/smp-menus/): SMP Menus provides help and rules menus as an alternative to DeluxeMenus. Menus are defined in configuration with a menu-driven interface.
- [SMP Protections features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/smp-protections/): SMP Protections provides ProtectionStones-style claims with menus. It requires SMP Regions at runtime and is configured through a main config and messages file.
- [SMP Punishments operations and configuration](https://arkflame.com/docs/smp-punishments/): SMP Punishments commands, permissions, storage and warning settings, including multi-server sync.
- [SMP Regions resets, flags and commands](https://arkflame.com/docs/smp-regions/): SMP Regions resets tracked temporary blocks in cuboid regions on a timer. Flags, commands, permissions and cache behaviour.
- [SMP Rewards features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/smp-rewards/): SMP Rewards adds daily and hourly rewards with streaks, menus and playtime tracking. Four commands and ten permissions cover configuration and player access.
- [SMP Shards features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/smp-shards/): SMP Shards adds an AFK-earned shard currency and a shop that spends it. The current source targets Paper and Folia 1.21.4+ and ships nine configuration files.
- [SMP Weapons features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/smp-weapons/): SMP Weapons adds configurable legendary weapons for SMP, PvP and FFA play. Arsenal menus, item definitions and messages are included.
- [SquidGameX features and compatibility](https://arkflame.com/docs/squidgamex/): SquidGameX runs large Squid Game-style events with a set of game and configuration files. It is built for Bukkit, Spigot, Paper and Folia servers.
- [StaffModeX staff mode, vanish and reports](https://arkflame.com/docs/staffmodex/): StaffModeX adds staff mode, vanish, staff chat, freeze, reports and inspection tools to Bukkit servers, with optional proxy and Redis transport.
- [VeloFlame quick start](https://arkflame.com/docs/veloflame/): Velocity proxy fork adding antibot, rate limiting, firewall, whitelist, and maintenance commands, built with a Java 25 toolchain.

## Guides

- [A plugin won't start: reproduce, capture, bisect](https://arkflame.com/guides/plugin-troubleshooting-workflow/): Work from a full stack trace and exact versions, verify hard dependencies and config paths, check permission nodes, then bisect plugin jars.
- [An SMP essentials plugin stack that stays small](https://arkflame.com/guides/smp-essentials-plugin-stack/): Build an SMP plugin stack from EssentialsLite, SMP Rewards, SMP Shards, SMP Menus and SMP Crates. Order, dependencies and what to test first.
- [Anti-bot setup for BungeeCord and Velocity](https://arkflame.com/guides/anti-bot-setup-bungeecord-velocity/): Set up anti-bot protection on a BungeeCord or Velocity proxy with FlameCord or VeloFlame, then lock the backends behind it.
- [Anticheat on Folia: what to check first](https://arkflame.com/guides/anticheat-folia-checklist/): Before you trust an anticheat on Folia, check its dependencies, scheduling, alerts and optional hooks. FairPlay is the worked example.
- [AuthMePremium Mode A vs Mode B: install and trust](https://arkflame.com/guides/authme-premium-topologies/): Choose AuthMePremium Mode A or Mode B by proxy type and AuthMe version, then wire proxy UUID approval, bridge tokens and private backend ports correctly.
- [Choosing an anticheat for Paper and Folia](https://arkflame.com/guides/anticheat-for-paper-and-folia/): What to check before you run an anticheat on Paper or Folia: dependencies, the Folia flag, alerts and false positives. FairPlay is the worked example.
- [Crash and dupe protection checklist for Minecraft servers](https://arkflame.com/guides/crash-and-dupe-protection-checklist/): A checklist for crash, dupe and packet-exploit protection on Spigot and Paper, using ExploitFixer with entity, block and redstone limits.
- [Diagnose the lag source before installing another limiter](https://arkflame.com/guides/diagnose-lag-before-limiters/): Measure TPS, tick time and hot paths first, then choose EntityLimiter, RedstoneLimiter, MobStacker or BlockLimiter based on what is actually costing ticks.
- [DiscordSRV alternative: DiscordFlow](https://arkflame.com/guides/discordsrv-alternative-discordflow/): DiscordFlow as a DiscordSRV alternative: role sync, chat sync, proximity voice and console access, with platform scope and a test plan.
- [EssentialsX alternative for Folia servers](https://arkflame.com/guides/essentialsx-alternative-folia/): EssentialsLite as an essentials suite for Folia, what its Folia claim does and does not prove, and a checklist before you swap it in.
- [FairPlay false positives: inspect, trace, change one check](https://arkflame.com/guides/fairplay-false-positives/): Use /fp alerts inspect and /fp latency diagnostics to verify a FairPlay flag before disabling checks, changing exemptions or recording an ML window.
- [FlameCord vs VeloFlame: pick by proxy ecosystem, not speed](https://arkflame.com/guides/flamecord-vs-veloflame/): FlameCord is a BungeeCord/Waterfall fork and VeloFlame a Velocity fork, so compare protocol tables, build targets, firewall defaults and migration limits.
- [Folia-compatible plugins: what the flag covers](https://arkflame.com/guides/folia-compatible-plugins/): Which ArkFlame plugins declare Folia support in their repositories, which rely on store listings, and what to verify before you run them.
- [Lock backend ports to the proxy, keep AuthMePremium trust](https://arkflame.com/guides/secure-proxy-backend/): Separate backend reachability from proxy trust: bind and firewall backend ports, verify forwarding, then fix AuthMe UUID approval or token mismatches.
- [Migrate a Paper server to Folia: a plugin checklist](https://arkflame.com/guides/migrate-paper-to-folia-checklist/): A Paper-to-Folia migration checklist: audit each plugin's Folia claim, test in order, check dependencies and read region-ownership errors.
- [Protect an SMP from griefing and exploits](https://arkflame.com/guides/protect-smp-from-griefing-and-exploits/): Protect an SMP with claims, region flags and exploit filters. SMP Protections, SMP Regions, ProtectionStones Extras, ExploitFixer and SMP Combat compared.
- [Protecting a Velocity proxy from bot attacks](https://arkflame.com/guides/velocity-proxy-bot-protection/): Layer host firewall, whitelist, maintenance mode and connection limits on a Velocity proxy, using the controls VeloFlame and FlameCord document.
- [Reduce entity lag with mob and item stacking](https://arkflame.com/guides/reduce-entity-lag-with-stacking/): Stack mobs and ground items to cut entity count, then cap what still grows. MobStacker, FlameStack, EntityLimiter and BlockLimiter compared.
- [Reduce redstone lag without breaking farms](https://arkflame.com/guides/redstone-lag-without-breaking-farms/): Measure redstone and entity load in monitor mode, then cap the machines causing lag with per-material overrides so working farms keep running.
- [Set up Discord role and chat sync with DiscordFlow](https://arkflame.com/guides/discord-role-and-chat-sync-setup/): Connect a Minecraft network to Discord with DiscordFlow: role sync, chat sync, proximity voice and console access, plus the bridge you need on a proxy.
- [SMP moderation setup: punishments, staff mode and chat](https://arkflame.com/guides/smp-moderation-and-punishments-setup/): Set up SMP moderation with SMP Punishments, StaffModeX and ChatSentinel: bans, mutes, warnings, staff tools and chat filters, in a safe order.
- [Stop chat spam and advertising on a Minecraft server](https://arkflame.com/guides/stop-chat-spam-and-advertising/): Block advertising, swearing and flood in Minecraft chat with ChatSentinel. Blacklists, alerts, mutes and what the plugin does not do.
- [Tune ExploitFixer packet limits from /ef logs](https://arkflame.com/guides/exploitfixer-packet-abuse/): Read /ef logs and /ef checks to find the module behind packet alerts, then tune packet-limiter limits and watchdog budgets without disconnecting players.
- [What folia-supported: true proves, and how to verify](https://arkflame.com/guides/folia-compatibility/): A folia-supported flag is a declaration, not a scheduler audit; check region ownership, entity tasks and FoliaAPI adapters, not just the flag.
